'''Skeendu''' was a hidden base established by the [[Skavers|Skaver]] gang on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Skeebo]]. The [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] [[Rescue of Anachro|rescued]] [[Anachro]] from there.<ref name="FatLady">''[[Boba Fett: When the Fat Lady Swings]]''</ref>
